source_text: In Hadith literature, a narration attributed to Umm Atiyyah in Sunan Abi Dawud (5271) reports that a woman performing circumcisions in Medina was instructed by the Prophet Muhammad: "Do not cut severely as that is better for a woman and more desirable for a husband." [38]
